_what_this_is: Reviewed, enumerated exceptions to the grading-floor guard in
tests/test_autocode_escalation.py (S12 AC4, card 9a7c0a86).
The guard asserts that no file on the grading floor differs from the
branch's base. That assertion is correct for ONE card and wrong for a
COMPOSED branch: card A never touches the floor, card B legitimately does,
and A's guard then reports B's change as A's violation (card 3f6719e4).
This file is how a floor change gets ACCEPTED, in writing, once.
AN ENTRY IS PINNED TO CONTENT, NOT TO A PATH. `blob` is the git blob sha
of the exact reviewed post-image. A path allowance would be a permanent
hole: every later edit to that file would ride in free. A content pin
expires the instant anything else lands on the file, so the next change
goes red and gets its own review. That is the difference between an
allowance and a mute button.
THIS FILE IS ITSELF ON protected._ALWAYS_PROTECTED. A diff that adds an
entry can therefore never auto-merge; it always routes to a human. The
'reviewed, not automatic' property is structural, not a convention that
depends on somebody remembering it.
FAIL CLOSED: if this file is missing, unreadable or unparseable, the guard
reads it as allowing NOTHING, and every floor change is a violation.
MAINTENANCE: an entry goes inert once its change is in the base (the file
no longer differs, so it is never consulted). Inert entries are harmless
but should be pruned when the epic closes, so this list stays a short
record of live exceptions rather than a growing pile of old ones.
